description: This file contains partial class definitions for ActivationRebalancerWorker, focusing on logging methods using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging. It defines various logging messages related to the rebalancing process in Orleans runtime, including session management, silos status, entropy metrics, and migration actions.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerWorker
classes.description: Partial class implementing logging methods for activation rebalancing in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: LogScheduledToStart
methods.description: Logs when the activation rebalancer has been scheduled to start after a specified due time.

methods.name: LogSessionStarted
methods.description: Logs the start of a new rebalancing session.

methods.name: LogSessionStopped
methods.description: Logs the stopping of the current rebalancing session.

methods.name: LogSuspended
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing has been suspended indefinitely.

methods.name: LogSuspendedFor
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing has been suspended for a specific duration.

methods.name: LogNotEnoughSilos
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing cannot continue due to insufficient silos.

methods.name: LogNotEnoughStatistics
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing cannot continue due to insufficient statistics information.

methods.name: LogInvalidSiloMemory
methods.description: Logs a warning when at least one silo reports zero memory usage, indicating potential missing implementation of IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider.

methods.name: LogMaxStagnantCyclesReached
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing has stopped due to reaching the maximum number of stagnant cycles.

methods.name: LogMaxEntropyDeviationReached
methods.description: Logs that rebalancing has stopped due to entropy deviation being within acceptable limits.

methods.name: LogInsufficientEntropyQuantum
methods.description: Logs that the entropy change is too small to consider an improvement.

methods.name: LogStagnantCyclesReset
methods.description: Logs that stagnant cycle count has been reset.

methods.name: LogFailedSessionsReset
methods.description: Logs that failed session count has been reset.

methods.name: LogSiloMigrations
methods.description: Logs details about migration of activations between silos, including pre- and post-activation counts.

methods.name: LogCycleOutcome
methods.description: Logs the outcome of a rebalancing cycle, including entropy metrics and stagnant cycles.
